FN Squad policies

Editorial standards

How FreakyNews chooses sources, labels stories and handles corrections.

On this pageScope and labelsSourcing and verificationCorrections and requestsCare, fairness and rightsBahasa Melayu

Scope and labels

FreakyNews publishes community-curated links and summaries. Identify company announcements, reported news and opinion so readers can tell them apart.

Sourcing and verification

Prefer identifiable primary sources and trustworthy reporting. Check the date, original context and corroboration, and include a link for readers. Attribute claims from companies and public figures to their source.

Corrections and requests

Use the editorial contact and include the story link, the statement in question and any source that can help verify it. When we substantively correct a story, explain the change where readers can see it.

Care, fairness and rights

Take extra care with allegations, minors, private information and sensitive topics. Leave out unnecessary identifying information. Credit sources and respect copyright when using other people’s work.

Piawaian Editorial FreakyNews

Utamakan sumber asal dan laporan yang boleh dipercayai. Semak tarikh, konteks dan bukti sokongan. Nyatakan sumber dan bezakan pengumuman, laporan berita dan pendapat.

Berhati-hati dengan dakwaan dan maklumat yang mengenal pasti individu, terutamanya kanak-kanak. Untuk pembetulan, berikan pautan artikel dan butiran kesilapan melalui saluran editorial.
